title: Paper-assembly scaffolding: claim JSON → markdown skeleton (Refs #5)
author: Pukujan
body_excerpt:
## Problem

Need a deterministic path from classify claim JSON records to a medium-quality markdown research-paper skeleton with provenance/lineage/citations — without any non-JEV LLM for labels or prose.

## What changes

- `src/jev_classifier/paper/` — `assemble_paper` / `validate_paper_markdown` (templates only)
- `tests/fixtures/paper/claims_golden.json` + pytest `tests/test_paper_assemble.py…
